notes.title: Open Playtests Available Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey pilots![/p][p]Take full control of a mechanized warrior and enter the arena. Recharged is a VR multiplayer fighting game where your real-world movements drive high-impact 1v1 robot battles built for skill, speed, and style.[/p][p]Recharged is a new kind of VR fighting game — fast, physical, and built for maximizing skill. In this 1v1 mech brawler, you control a powerful robot using your own movements. But here’s a twist: you don’t just throw punches — you strike a floating sphere in front of you to trigger attacks. Your fists become the controls, and pulling off combos is all about rhythm, reflex, and precision.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="89gzYyl-HQY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The Recharged public playtest is now live on Steam — and we want [i]you[/i] to help shape the future of the game. Jump in, test your skills against other pilots, and show us what you’ve got. We’re testing core systems, gathering data, and listening closely to your feedback. If you prefer to play standalone, no worries - we have Meta Quests playtests running. Join our [url="https://discord.gg/ppmfWcQ78c"]Main Discord[/url] or [url="https://discord.com/invite/3Fh4ekCkec"]Playtest Discord[/url] to chat with the dev team, report bugs, or just hang out with fellow fighters.[/p][p]Play now, fight hard — and help us make Recharged the ultimate VR fighter.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in the arena,[/p][p]– Team Recharged[/p][p]
[/p]
